name: codex-voice-notify
description: Offline multilingual voice notifications for Codex lifecycle events on macOS and Windows.

interface.longDescription: Play local, privacy-preserving voice notifications for ten Codex lifecycle events on macOS and Windows. Complete guided first-time setup, choose a warm husky or deep bright voice in Korean, Japanese, English, Russian, or Simplified Chinese, configure events, and mute or test playback without sending conversation data anywhere.
defaultPrompt: Set up Voice Notify: female Korean. Update Codex if needed, then open a new Codex CLI terminal so I can enter /hooks there.
Change Voice Notify to the male Russian voice.
Use the female Simplified Chinese voice and show me how to control Voice Notify.
